title: Sindhu Claims Japan Open Title with Dominant Win Over Yamaguchi
indian_angle: Indian star PV Sindhu secured a significant international title, marking a strong comeback and silencing doubters.
summary: PV Sindhu defeated home contender Akane Yamaguchi in a scorching performance to win her maiden Japan Open title, ending a period of doubt about her form.

title: Sindhu, Shetty Exit China Open After Wasting Match Points

summary: PV Sindhu and Ayush Shetty both squandered multiple match points in their respective matches, leading to their elimination from the China Open Super 1000 tournament.

summary: Indian junior Ayush Shetty defeated Alwi Farhan in a closely contested match at the China Open, showcasing a promising performance from the future star.

title: BAI Releases Eligibility Criteria for World Junior Championships 2026
indian_angle: The Badminton Association of India has issued crucial guidelines for selecting Indian players for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships in Cairo.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has released the eligibility criteria for Indian players aspiring to participate in the BWF World Junior Championships 2026, to be held in Cairo, Egypt.

title: 3x15 Scoring System to Debut in Indian Domestic Badminton
indian_angle: A new 3x15 scoring system is being implemented across all domestic ranking tournaments and national championships in India, impacting junior categories.
summary: The Badminton Association of India will implement a new 3x15 scoring system for all domestic ranking tournaments and national championships in the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups, debuting at Ernakulam.

title: World Championships in Delhi: Attracting Gen Z and Alpha Fans

summary: An opinion piece discusses the need for badminton to attract Gen Z and Gen Alpha audiences, especially with the upcoming World Championships being held in Delhi, India.
